title: Access and roles matrix
intro: Who may open each screen, who may do each job, which sign-offs are fixed by role, and what no role may ever do. The code's defaults are shown; where the live setting can differ, the item says so.

blocks.p: Rights belong to roles, never to a person. Each login holds 1 O2S role. 4 checks decide, in this order:

head: Check
What it answers
Where it is set
Code
rows: May this role open the screen (View) or work on it (Edit)?
The access matrix (masters.accessMatrix), COO only. With no cell set: every role may view, and the roles in the screen's owners list may edit.
May this role do this job (for example packing.pack)?
Live rights (RIGHTS_LIVE) are read from the grant table (masters.roleRights, keyed by role id). Other rights still run the exact old check written in the right's legacy block.
May this role sign off somebody else's work?
Fixed in code by role name. Never follows the matrix.
Did this same person do the step before?
Fixed in code, checked on the login (and on the typed name for a COA).
coaSamePerson, truckMadeByMe, pmvSame, approveShortClose, smpCheck, smpReview

blocks.note: The COO passes checks 1 to 3 (accessLevelOn, mayRole and hardRole answer yes for COO), with fixed exceptions: the COO does not sign a COA (coaReview asks for AQCM or a cover, coaApprove for QCM or a cover; the COO keeps assigning tests (labAssignConfirm) and superseding an approved COA (CORRECT_ENTITY supersede QCM, COO); he cannot send a COA back (coaSendBack)), does not submit a COA draft (coaSubmitAnalyst: Lab Rep only), does not review or release a free sample (smpReview, smpRelease), does not name or end a lab leave cover (labSetCover, labEndCover: Plant Manager only) and does not mark a Big pack run seen (bigPackSeen: Production Manager only). On truck review and the sample QA check the COO is exempt from the same-person rule.

Why sign-offs never follow the matrix: on 30 July 2026 a screen Edit grant given to Supply Chain Officer for an ordinary reason let that login approve and release DCs (canEdit lets a screen grant win). hardRole was made for that.

Can never
rows: Inspect a packing run they keyed with the same login (inspectorGate), or type another name as the inspector.
Review or approve a COA they drafted or tested; approve a COA they reviewed; sign both lines of 1 certificate as a leave cover.

Sign a COA or submit its draft (he may assign tests and supersede an approved COA; he cannot send one back: coaSendBack is AQCM or QCM only, and coaReject has no caller); review or release a free sample; name or end a lab leave cover; mark a Big pack run seen.
Review a truck they loaded, passed out or fixed. Approve the final DC or release a truck.
Approve their own short close or their own stock move.
Check a free sample he issued.
Review a free sample whose gate pass he issued.
Tick his own rights; tick a right he does not hold; tick a right of another department; tick a COO-only right.

Change the access matrix, add, rename or archive a role, set a department lead, change a list value, open Correct a record, approve a batch number correction, reopen a short-closed line, close a whole PO, approve a free sample.
Every role but the COO and the CFO

Approve a new customer. Approve or refuse a purchase requisition, unless the COO has given that role an Edit grant in the access matrix on the screen where the button is drawn (canEdit(['CFO']) lets a screen grant win, the 30 July 2026 pattern).
Every role but COO, CFO, Plant Manager, KAM
See money figures (Finance sees them on the Invoicing report only).
Rename or archive a built-in role. Delete their own login, delete or demote the last COO, switch off their own login or the last platform administrator (server).

blocks.p: At grant time, 5 pairs may not sit on 1 role (SEPARATION): enter production and inspect; draft and review a COA; review and approve a COA; load and release a truck; raise an order and approve its DC. A tick that would break a pair is refused with the reason, and Back Office shows a pair already broken today.

blocks.note: Not confirmed: the Guide says 'Nobody inspects their own output'. In code this is checked only when a right is ticked (separationRefusal), not per person at the inspection itself. Ask: should a QA inspection refuse the login that packed the lot? A) yes, per person; B) no, the role check is enough. From 16b, the packed lot and truck QA sheets refuse a person who keyed a packing run on the sheet (D-287); other outputs are still checked only at grant time.

Not confirmed: approving a purchase requisition still uses canEdit(['CFO']), which a screen Edit grant can widen, unlike the truck and lab sign-offs (hardRole). Ask: should approving a requisition be A) CFO and COO only, fixed like the other sign-offs; B) left as it is?
